summary: California Resources Corp filed an 8-K reporting the closing of a $550M private offering of 7.250% senior unsecured notes due 2035. Proceeds, together with cash on hand or revolver borrowings, were used to redeem all outstanding $550M of its 8.250% senior notes due 2029 at 104.125% of par plus accrued interest, completed the same day. The notes are guaranteed by existing subsidiaries and rank equally with senior unsecured debt. Redemption prices and change-of-control put at 101% are specified. This is a routine refinancing—a liability management transaction replacing one debt instrument with another—not an equity special situation. No shareholder vote, premium to market, or strategic catalyst applies.
